g.text: pH measures hydrogen-ion activity; hardness and alkalinity measure different chemical properties

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Dilute aqueous teaching scale at25°C: pH=−log10(a_H+),neutral pH≈7. Neutral pH depends on temperature; pH can lie outside0–14. Hardness and alkalinity may

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: share CaCO₃-equivalent units but are not interchangeable or determined by pH alone. Colored scale indicates acidity, not safety or potability.
